name: Hodoki Clinic
description: Hodoki Clinic is a physiotherapy clinic at 2F, 41 Alder Street, Fernhill, opened in 2015 by Clara Mendes for desk workers and people after surgery. This block theme opens on a full-bleed photograph with the headline at the bottom left and an info bar, then tells the story as problem, method and one recovered case, with an arch-topped photograph, a giant light-serif phrase carrying two photographs off the page edges, tall photograph cards, a rounded parallax band and a seven-item price list in USD. Source Serif 4 for headings, Nunito Sans for reading. Sample content in English.
